charts.name: Nauru reference chart of accounts
charts.legal_reference: Nauru prescribes no chart of accounts that this pack's research found. The Nauru Revenue Office publishes the taxes it administers (consulted 7 November 2026): business profits tax, small business tax and non-resident tax under the Business Tax Act 2016, employment and services tax withheld by the payer under the Employment and Services Tax Act 2014, and telecommunications service tax; none of the pages read numbers accounts. This chart is therefore original: four digits, blocked so that each range reaches one line item of the statement of financial position and the statement of profit or loss, following IAS 1. It carries a business profits tax provision with its quarterly instalments, a payable for employment and services tax and non-resident tax withheld, and no tax-clearing account for a turnover tax, because Nauru has no general one in force. The name of the Nauruan-language terms a Nauruan accountant would use is not supplied: see the README.

numbering.legal_reference: Nauru has no general turnover tax in force that this pack's research found, so no tax invoice regime conditions a tax position on an invoice carrying a sequential number (see the tax codes NR-S-NA and NR-P-NA). This pack's research did not read the Corporations Act, the Revenue Administration Act or any text on the books a Nauruan business must keep or for how long; `numbering` is `free` and `number_format` is a convention this pack proposes. A local reviewer should confirm there is no rule.

payment_terms.legal_reference: This pack's research found no Nauruan text setting a payment term between two businesses in the absence of an agreement, or a statutory rate of late-payment interest on a commercial debt; it did not search for one. `legal_payment_days` and `late_payment_reference` are therefore empty and a seller's terms are a matter of contract.

tax_point.legal_reference: This field has no true value for Nauru: it names the day a country's general rule makes its own turnover tax chargeable, and no such tax is in force. `invoice_date` is declared as the closest commercial convention — a convention, not a rule read from a text, and not a statement about when business profits tax or the employment and services tax withholding arises (the latter on the day the payer pays the income or fee, Employment and Services Tax Q and A Guide 2022-2023, question 1).

einvoicing.legal_reference: This pack's research found no Nauruan law obliging a business to issue or accept an electronic invoice, and no Peppol Authority for Nauru; the Nauru Revenue Office pages read (consulted 7 November 2026) mention none, and the official legislation database (ronlaw.gov.nr) could not be searched. `obligation` is therefore `none` and `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null; no VAT identifier exists for a scheme to carry. This is an absence of evidence and a local reviewer should confirm it.
